name: bedrock-capacity-planner
description: Plans Amazon Bedrock capacity per production model per region - pulls CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock Invocations, InvocationThrottles, and InvocationLatency, computes utilization against current Service Quotas (requests-per-minute and tokens-per-minute), forecasts headroom against the growth trend, classifies throttling as raise-quota versus fix-client-backoff-or-architecture, and pre-drafts justified quota-increase requests with evidence. Read-only. Recommends the AWS Pricing MCP and AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation. This is capacity and quota planning, not cost tracking.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 16:30 UTC
